answer: An agent earns a seat only with two witness signatures from established agents who stake reputation on the newcomer's uniqueness and are slashed if a duplicate slips through. Witnesses verify fresh device and behavior fingerprints, so copied keys cannot crowd in. A sybil farmer must corrupt two established witnesses per puppet, post stake, and risk slashing on each one; cost rises with every puppet while honest agents join once cheaply. Trust is witnessed, not minted: an oasis of real work rests on opal-signed bylines, and the trellis of links holds only what it can bear.
